  "description": "Ignite Energy Access is an Abu Dhabi-based leader in distributed renewable energy solutions, dedicated to providing affordable, reliable, and sustainable electricity to underserved communities across Africa. Now operating across 12 countries and serving over 15million people. Through innovative technology, scalable business models, and impact-driven financing, Ignite Power is transforming lives, fostering economic growth, and driving the continent&rsquo;s clean energy transition.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Stock Holding Officer&nbsp;

Job Locations: Itu &amp; Etinan - Akwa Ibom, Ahuoada - Rivers and Otueke - Bayelsa
Employment Type: Contract

Job Purpose/Mission


	The Customer Experience Unit is looking for a bright, highly motivated and disciplined Stock Holding Officerwith a passion for entrepreneurship, renewable energy, and financial inclusion to join our team.
	IEA Nigeria prides itself on always putting the customer first; the Stock Holding Officer will be at the forefront of providing world-class customer service to our SmartLife customer across Nigeria.
	As the main point of contact at the Service Center, the role will be to deal with and help resolve any customer complaints while giving the best possible customer experience as well as going beyond call of duty when required.


Key Responsibilities


	Always provide excellent customer service to all IEA Nigeria customers.
	Attract new and existing customers to the Service center.
	Supervise the movement &amp; stock count of IEA Nigeria inventory to and from the Service Center.
	Provide periodic reports on customer engagement and stock count to Service Center Team Lead.


Deliverables and Activities
Customer Engagement:


	Customer Liaison: Serve as a liaison between the customer and IEA
	Information Accuracy: Always provide accurate product information to customers and never oversell or lie to customers about our product capabilities
	Courtesy Calls: Make courtesy calls to IEA customers as requested
	End-to-end Experience: Ensure all IEA customers have a great end-to-end customer experience.


Problem Solving:


	Resolve Customer Queries: Resolve customer requests, questions and complaints while frequently analyzing situations to determine best use of resources
	Diagnose Technical Issues: Diagnose technical issues with the customer units and support in the swapping process
	Escalation to Manager: Escalate issues or questions to manager if you cannot resolve them.


Data Management:


	Inventory Reporting: Provide regular reports on sales unit inventory, service unit inventory, and customer data handling and management
	Data Entry: Always enter accurate and honest information into the IEA data systems. Ensure data entry is high quality so that data can be used to better serve our customers
	Customer Feedback Data: Help collect data on Customer feedback and satisfaction.


Inventory Management:


	Unit Inventory: Supervise and monitor the collection and disbursement of sales and service unit inventory (including accessories) in the Service Center


Product Development:


	Assist with product development through conducting field tests and surveys when required.


Requirements


	Qualifications: Degree or Diploma in a relevant field from a recognized institution
	Experience: 1-2 years of experience in customer service and inventory management
	Language(s): English.


Knowledge and skills:


	Critical thinking and good problem-solving skills (solutions oriented)
	Good influencing and negotiation skills.
	Flexibility with ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines.
	Competent with computers including Microsoft Office packages and other Google products such as Forms, Sheets, Docs and Slides etc.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Team player who can work independently.
	Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external customers.
	Demonstrate a high level of professionalism and integrity.
	Working knowledge of IP networking and configuration&nbsp;
	Good people skills
	Ability to organize, multi-task and prioritize tasks
	Ability to make recommendations to effectively resolve problems or issues.


Salary
N60,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: career-ng@igniteaccess.com using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the mail.",

	The Guest Service Executive is responsible for delivering a premium, personalised, and seamless guest experience throughout the Cube journey.

	Deliver exceptional hospitality and ensure a seamless guest experience throughout the Cube journey.
	Coordinate guest bookings, verify booking details, and ensure all guest requirements and special requests are accurately communicated and fulfilled.
	Supervise host / hostess pre-arrival checks to ensure the cinema, amenities, food, beverages, and other booking inclusions are ready to the required standard.
	Brief guests on the Cube experience, facilities, and available services.
	Monitor guest experiences discreetly and proactively attend to guest needs and requests.
	Handle guest enquiries, feedback, and complaints professionally, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation where necessary.
	Provide personalised service to VIPs, celebrities, corporate clients, and guests celebrating special occasions, while maintaining confidentiality and discretion.

	Build positive guest relationships and encourage repeat visits and customer loyalty.
	Work collaboratively with Operations, Food &amp; Beverage, Cinema, Housekeeping, Security, Marketing, Finance, and other relevant teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

	Adhere to all Cube service standards, SOPs, company policies, health and safety requirements, and professional grooming standards.

	Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
	Sales, upselling, and relationship management skills.
	Good computer literacy and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
	Professional appearance, excellent grooming, discretion, and confidentiality.
	Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, public holidays, and peak movie release periods.

Guest Service Executive (GSE) Job at Filmhouse Cinemas Limited




        
    

        
        Filmhouse Cinemas Limited is a dynamic film exhibition company. Our expertise are in the areas of: Cinema operations, management of sites, Ownership of sites, Consultancy for cinema development, Design Fit-out; Cinema project management, Film Distribution: Rights Acquisition, Booking into cinemas, and content development.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Guest Service Executive (GSE)

Job Location: Lekki Estate Road, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	The Guest Service Executive is responsible for delivering a premium, personalised, and seamless guest experience throughout the Cube journey.
	The role serves as a key point of contact for guests, ensuring exceptional service from pre-arrival through departure while supporting booking operations, guest satisfaction, service recovery, and revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Welcome and attend to guests professionally, warmly, and with a personalised approach.
	Deliver exceptional hospitality and ensure a seamless guest experience throughout the Cube journey.
	Coordinate guest bookings, verify booking details, and ensure all guest requirements and special requests are accurately communicated and fulfilled.
	Supervise host / hostess pre-arrival checks to ensure the cinema, amenities, food, beverages, and other booking inclusions are ready to the required standard.
	Brief guests on the Cube experience, facilities, and available services.
	Monitor guest experiences discreetly and proactively attend to guest needs and requests.
	Handle guest enquiries, feedback, and complaints professionally, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation where necessary.
	Provide personalised service to VIPs, celebrities, corporate clients, and guests celebrating special occasions, while maintaining confidentiality and discretion.
	Promote approved Cube packages, upgrades, add-ons, merchandise, and other services to support sales and revenue targets.
	Build positive guest relationships and encourage repeat visits and customer loyalty.
	Work collaboratively with Operations, Food & Beverage, Cinema, Housekeeping, Security, Marketing, Finance, and other relevant teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
	Maintain accurate records of bookings, guest feedback, complaints, special requests, and service recovery actions.
	Adhere to all Cube service standards, SOPs, company policies, health and safety requirements, and professional grooming standards.


Requirements
Qualifications:


	Minimum Education Qualification: Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc./B.A./B.Tech.) from a recognised institution.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in guest services, customer service, hospitality, luxury retail, premium entertainment, hotel operations, aviation, or a related customer-facing role.
	Experience in a luxury hospitality or premium customer experience environment is an advantage.


Requires Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
	High emotional intelligence, empathy, and conflict-resolution ability.
	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
	Sales, upselling, and relationship management skills.
	Good computer literacy and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
	Professional appearance, excellent grooming, discretion, and confidentiality.
	Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, public holidays, and peak movie release periods.

 Job Position: Administrative and Accounting Officer

Job Location: Abuja
Employment type: Full-time

	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing accounting operations and providing administrative support to ensure efficient office management.
	The role requires prior experience in the travel industry and a good understanding of the IATA Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) processes.

Accounting Duties:


	Maintain accurate financial records in line with company policies
	Manage accounts payable and receivable processes
	Perform bank reconciliations and BSP reconciliation
	Prepare sales invoices and periodic financial reports (weekly/monthly)
	Ensure timely remittance of airline ticket sales through BSP
	Assist with statutory compliance (VAT, WHT, PAYE, etc.)
	Support internal and external audit processes

	Coordinate daily office operations and administrative activities
	Maintain proper documentation and filing systems
	Liaise with vendors, airlines, and service providers
	Support travel consultants with booking documentation where necessary
	Handle correspondence and general office management tasks

	Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (B.Sc./HND) in Accounting
	Minimum of Second Class Lower / Lower Credit


Professional Qualifications:


	ACA (Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria) or ACCA certification (or in view) is highly desirable
	Membership of relevant professional bodies is an added advantage
	IATA/UFTAA certification or training will be an added advantage


Experience Requirements:


	2–3 years of relevant work experience
	Must have experience working in a travel agency or IATA-accredited organisation
	Practical knowledge of BSP processes is required
	Familiarity with GDS systems (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo) is an advantage


Required Skills:


	Strong accounting and financial reporting skills
	Knowledge of Nigerian tax regulations (VAT, WHT, PAYE)
	Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Sage, QuickBooks)
	Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
	High level of accuracy and attention to detail
	Strong organisational and time management skills
	Good written and verbal communication skills


Personal Attributes:


	Integrity and high ethical standards
